prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: unlabeled topographic base for a navigable literary map in an Anne of Green Gables reading edition
Primary request: A historically grounded illustrated topographic map of Prince Edward Island circa 1890, showing the complete recognizable long crescent coastline, Northumberland Strait and Gulf of St. Lawrence, subtle coastal shallows, red sandstone cliffs, rolling agricultural fields, wooded ridges, rivers and inlets.
Style/medium: mature late nineteenth-century hand-painted atlas plate, refined watercolor and engraved relief, realistic cartography, restrained archival finish
Composition/framing: exact overhead map view, north at top, the whole island centered with generous sea margin, landscape 16:10, coastline geographically recognizable and uninterrupted
Color palette: muted red earth, moss and spruce greens, parchment cream, desaturated blue-green water
Constraints: map only; no title, labels, words, letters, numbers, compass, legend, border, pins, route lines, ships, people, perspective horizon, decorative vignette, or watermark; leave clear terrain for deterministic overlays
Avoid: fantasy map, children’s drawing, satellite photo, modern roads, modern buildings, pseudo-text, distorted island silhouette
inspection: Accepted after visual review. Rich island terrain is clipped to the verified Natural Earth coastline; open-water texture is sampled separately so generated shoreline drift cannot alter geography.
